[fruitJam:buttonPressed].summary: Reads the requested onboard Fruit Jam button.
[fruitJam:buttonPressed].returns: Boolean pressed state; use a button index supported by the board firmware.
prerequisites: Import Fruit Jam and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. Fruit Jam button: number; library example 1.

examples.title: Use Fruit Jam button … pressed?
examples.explanation: Block notation: Reads the requested onboard Fruit Jam button. Boolean pressed state; use a button index supported by the board firmware.

notes: Experimental Fruit Jam Zephyr port. Five onboard NeoPixels: index 1..5, RGB 0..255; start with values of 8. SHT4x work was stopped at user request and remains unvalidated/inactive. See the repository capability manifest for physical test status.
Source: boards\adafruit_fruit_jam\integration\Fruit_Jam.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.

[fruitJam:pixel].summary: Sets one of the five onboard NeoPixels with independent red/green/blue channels.
[fruitJam:pixel].returns: Command; index 1..5 and channels 0..255; begin with values around 8.
prerequisites: Import Fruit Jam and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. Fruit Jam pixel: number; library example 1.

examples.title: Use Fruit Jam pixel … red … green … blue …
examples.code: Fruit Jam pixel [1] red [8] green [0] blue [0]
examples.explanation: Block notation: Sets one of the five onboard NeoPixels with independent red/green/blue channels. Command; index 1..5 and channels 0..255; begin with values around 8.

notes: Experimental Fruit Jam Zephyr port. Five onboard NeoPixels: index 1..5, RGB 0..255; start with values of 8. SHT4x work was stopped at user request and remains unvalidated/inactive. See the repository capability manifest for physical test status.
